description: The librarian enters the member's name and email.
The library checks the email is not already registered and records the member.
The library shows the new member's ID, which goes on their card.
The librarian enters the tool's name and, optionally, a description.
The library records the tool in good condition and shows its ID, which goes on its tag.
The member picks a tool from the catalog.
The library checks the member can borrow and the tool can be lent.
The library records the loan and tells the member when it is due.
The librarian finds the loan and inspects the tool.
The librarian records the condition (`good` or `needs_repair`) and, optionally, a note.
The library ends the loan. A tool in good condition goes back on the shelf, unless damage was reported on it during the loan; a tool needing repair is taken out of lending.
The librarian marks the tool as needing repair and notes what is wrong.
Later, the librarian marks the tool repaired, and it can be lent again.
